name: agentscope
description: Windows-native control and trace layer for local AI coding agents.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build-outputs.mjs && npm --workspace @agentscope/shared run build && npm --workspace @agentscope/i18n run build && npm --workspace @agentscope/core run build && npm --workspace @agentscope/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @agentscope/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @agentscope/i18n run typecheck && npm --workspace @agentscope/core run typecheck && npm --workspace @agentscope/desktop run typecheck
scripts.i18n:check: npm --workspace @agentscope/i18n run build && npm --workspace @agentscope/i18n run check
scripts.check:release: npm run audit:repo && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run i18n:check && npm test && npm run smoke:agentscope && npm run package:pre && npm run verify:desktop-artifacts -- --strict-head && npm run smoke:desktop:packaged && npm run smoke:desktop:ipc-negative && npm run smoke:desktop:portable
